inscription.name: Kastlösa kyrka

carrier.currentLocationDescription: Nuvarande placering: Kastlösa kyrka, Kastlösa socken

textLayer.readingTransliteration: [askutr : raisti : stain : þina : iftʀ : suin : faþur : sina : kuþ : ialbi : ant : hans : a^uk : kus muþiʀ]
textLayer.normalizationRunicSwedish: Asgautr ræisti stæin þenna æftiʀ Svæin, faður sinn. Guð hialpi and hans ok Guðs moðiʀ.
textLayer.normalizationOldWestNorse: Ásgautr reisti stein þenna eptir Svein, fǫður sinn. Guð hjalpi ǫnd hans ok Guðs móðir.
textLayer.translationSwedish: … lät göra detta minnesmärke efter sin fader och efter sin broder … Krist hjälpe hans ande.
textLayer.translationEnglish: … had this monument made in memory of his father and in memory of his brother … May Christ help his spirit.
